content.text: •Affects 25% of patients who have abdominal surgery
collapse of lung tissue w/ loss of volume
; possible tracheal deviation towards affected side
in parts of lung remaining atelectatic >72h
: localized serious fluid collection not containing pus or blood, delay healing & ⇡ risk of wound infection
: collection of blood & clot caused by unsuccessful hemostasis or coagulation
: incisional skin/soft tissue or organ/space infection at recent surgery site,
purulent discharge from deep within incision
purulent discharge from a drain in organ/space
, additional features depend on organs affected
+/- imaging to assess for deep tissue or organ/space infection
*DELAYED CLOSURE, left to heal by secondary intention
